environment.description: Lambda deployed via EKS-hosted container (using AWS Lambda Web Adapter on EKS Fargate pods). The pod runs in namespace 'profile-svc' with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applied: spec.podSelector matchLabels app=profile-updater, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules allow TCP 443 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT deny-listed 169.254.169.254/32 via a preceding calico GlobalNetworkPolicy with order:100. Additionally, the Istio service mesh sidecar enforces strict mTLS peer authentication for the namespace, and the VirtualService routing requires a custom header 'X-CSRF-Nonce' matching a per-session HMAC stored in an Envoy-managed request header filter (lua filter at the gateway). Requests missing the nonce or with mismatched values receive 403 from the Envoy sidecar before reaching the application container. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy for the workload also restricts source principals to 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/apigw-sa', meaning only the internal API gateway pod can invoke the profile service directly.

config.calico_global_policy: order:100, deny egress to 169.254.169.254/32 for namespace profile-svc
config.envoy_lua_filter: validates X-CSRF-Nonce header against per-session HMAC-SHA256 before forwarding
